text: Attempt 1: ci.yml gate job timeout-minutes 120 -> 360 (GitHub hosted maximum) for every event; resource plan ci.yml/gate timeoutMinutes 360; hardening contract asserts gate timeout-minutes == 360 (red at 120 measured: expected 360 actual 120; green after); the Install gate CLI tools comment and the contract comment no longer cite a live 120-minute backstop; CHANGELOG Unreleased/Fixed names run 41431327759. Budget row ci_resources_not_plan_driven unchanged at 93 before and after.

Security finding for the owner (attempt 2 input): psvensson/lagrange is public and User-owned, so repository runners have no runner groups and any workflow whose labels match is eligible, including fork pull_request runs whose YAML the fork controls. The fork PR approval policy is already all_external_contributors (strictest) and must stay so; approving a fork run while PR gates route to the lab equals running that fork's code as peter on a home host. Collaborators: psvensson only. actions/permissions: allowed_actions all, sha_pinning_required false (workflows already pin by SHA).

Attempt 2 design written to evidence/design-note.md, awaiting the lead's decision; no workflow, runner or setting changed. Recommendation: keep pull-request gates hosted after attempt 1 (PR #188); a lab route conflicts with home-lab.md ('Do not attach trusted home machines to pull-request workflows in the public Lagrange repository'), the ci.yml header and the hardening contract assertion, so it is an owner policy change (R26). Measured/modelled times: whole corpus ~63 min controller, ~132 min hosted, ~82 min tv-dator, ~91 carinas-windows, 116-123 min for the three laptops (no faster than hosted). If the owner wants it anyway: tv-dator only, same-repo PRs only via vars.LAGRANGE_PR_GATE_RUNS_ON, PR #118 adapter adapted (machine lock + holder record kept, external thermal guard dropped as a second thermal authority, one lock around npm run check, LAGRANGE_PLACEMENT=local).
